provenance.note: Paths and identifiers renamed by stall-fixture-map.json; requirement/evidence text retained because the detector consumes it. See README.md.

findings.requirement: Frozen plan §4.2 and Q3=B: record the first real CloudKit use once.
findings.evidence: The once-only marker is called only at fetch() entry. Other supported paths reach the first real CloudKit call through availableDatabase() at line 1048, including save/delete flows, without invoking the marker. The Debug-only diagnostic probe also calls container.accountStatus() directly at line 723. If a Settings save or probe occurs before the startup fetch, T4 is absent or is logged later as if it were the first CloudKit use.
findings.required_fix: Move the marker to the common accountStatus boundary used by fetch/save/delete, and invoke the same once-only helper before the diagnostic probe's direct accountStatus call. Remove the fetch-only assumption and verify a first-save-before-fetch smoke path.

findings.requirement: Frozen plan §1 and §4.2 T3: measure CKContainer(identifier:) construction time.
findings.evidence: The timer starts at line 670 before CKContainer(identifier:) but the mark occurs at line 677 after stored-property assignments, container.privateCloudDatabase access, and CKRecord.ID construction at lines 673-675. The t3-container-init value therefore includes work beyond CKContainer construction.
findings.required_fix: Emit the T3 mark immediately after the CKContainer(identifier:) expression and before assigning database, recordID, or other stored properties.
